name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
ministry: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: Old age protection and social security scheme for Small and Marginal Farmers providing a minimum assured pension of ₹ 3,000 per month after age 60, with government matching contribution.
benefits: Minimum assured pension of ₹ 3,000 per month after attaining the age of 60 years; family pension of 50% to spouse; government matching contribution equal to subscriber's monthly contribution.
benefits_evidence: The subscriber will receive a minimum assured pension of ₹ 3,000/- per month after attaining the age of 60 years.
In case of death of the subscriber, the spouse will receive 50% of the pension amount as family pension.
The Government of India will contribute an amount equal to the subscriber’s monthly contribution to the pension fund.
level_evidence: "Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana" by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India is a government scheme meant for old age protection and social security of Small and Marginal Farmers (SMF).

rules.reason: Applicant must be a Small or Marginal Farmer with cultivable landholding
rules.evidence: The applicant should be a Small or Marginal Farmer.

rules.reason: Cultivable landholding must be up to 2 hectares
rules.evidence: The applicant should have cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares as per State or Union Territory land records.

rules.reason: Applicant must be at least 18 years of age at the time of entry
rules.evidence: The applicant should be between 18 and 40 years of age at the time of entry.

rules.reason: Applicant must be 40 years of age or younger at the time of entry
rules.evidence: The applicant should be between 18 and 40 years of age at the time of entry.

rules.reason: Serving or retired government employees are excluded

documents.item: Savings Bank Account Number along with IFSC Code ( Bank Passbook or Cheque Leaf/book or copy of bank statement as evidence of bank account)
documents.evidence: Savings Bank Account Number along with IFSC Code ( Bank Passbook or Cheque Leaf/book or copy of bank statement as evidence of bank account).

how_to_apply: Apply online via Common Service Centres (CSCs); visit the nearest CSC with Aadhaar Card and Savings Bank Account Number along with IFSC Code, pay the initial contribution amount in cash to the Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE), and complete enrolment.
how_to_apply_evidence: Step 1: The Eligible SMFs desirous of joining the scheme shall visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).

Step 2: Following are the prerequisites for the enrolment process: Aadhaar Card; Savings Bank Account Number along with IFSC Code ( Bank Passbook or Cheque Leave/book or copy of bank statement as evidence of bank account ).
Step 3: Initial contribution amount in cash will be made to the Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE).
